headline: Chinese airlines expect billions in losses
summary: China's three major airlines expect heavy losses after first-half losses, facing elevated fuel costs and softening travel demand. Their joint announcement came ahead of the peak summer travel season.
why: Major Chinese carriers such as Air China, China Eastern and China Southern are large listed airlines whose results depend heavily on fuel costs and demand.
